he.text: [The following instructions are only to be observed if there are ten persons present who fast till night; should there not be, the Ameedah is said immediately after Kaddish. The סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה is taken from the Ark, and the portion וַיְחַל (see end of volume) is read to three persons; the third person called reads הַפְטָרַת דִּרְשׁוּ (see end of volume.) After the סֵפֶר תּוֹרָה is returned to the Ark, the congregation say the Ameedah, introducing עֲנֵנוּ as on other fast days.] After the repetition thereof by the Reader the following is said—

en.text: [The following instructions are only to be observed if there are ten persons present who fast till night; should there not be, the Ameedah is said immediately after Kaddish. The Law is taken from the Ark, and the portion for fast days (see end of volume) is read to three persons; the third person called reads the Aftorah (see end of volume). After the Law is returned to the Ark, the Congregation say the Ameedah, introducing “O answer us,” as on other fast days. After the repetition thereof by the Reader, the following is said—
